    @pytest.mark.error
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("lang", LANGUAGES)
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "case", ERROR_CASES, ids=[c["id"] for c in ERROR_CASES]
    )
    def test_error_cases(
        entrypoint_argv: list[str],
        case: dict,
        lang: str,
        tmp_path: Path,
    ) -> None:
        """Error handling tests - should produce error status or fail gracefully."""
        case_copy = tmp_path / "case"
        shutil.copytree(case["path"], case_copy)
    
        entrypoint = case["entrypoint"]
    
        # Run generate - may fail for error cases
        gen_result = subprocess.run(
            entrypoint_argv
            + [
                "generate",
                str(case_copy),
                "--entrypoint",
                entrypoint,
                "--lang",
                lang,
            ],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=30,
        )
    
        # If generate failed with non-zero exit, that's acceptable
        if gen_result.returncode != 0:
            return
    
        # If generate succeeded, run test and expect error status
        ext = LANG_EXT[lang]
        solution_file = case_copy / f"solution.{ext}"
    
        if not solution_file.exists():
            solution_file = case_copy / "solution.py"
    
        test_result = subprocess.run(
            entrypoint_argv
            + [
                "test",
                str(solution_file),
                str(case_copy),
                "--lang",
                lang,
            ],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=30,
        )
    
        # Should get error status or non-zero exit
        if test_result.returncode == 2:
            return
    
        try:
            result = json.loads(test_result.stdout.strip())
>           assert result["status"] == "error", (
                f"Expected error status, got {result['status']}"
            )
E           AssertionError: Expected error status, got fail
E           assert 'fail' == 'error'
E             
E             - error
E             + fail

        case: dict,
        target_lang: str,
        tmp_path: Path,
    ) -> None:
        """Constraint violations in loops should produce error status."""
        case_dir = generate_case_dir(tmp_path, case, "py")
    
        # Run generate - may fail for error cases
        gen_cmd = entrypoint_argv + [
            "generate", str(case_dir),
            "--entrypoint", case["entrypoint"],
            "--lang", target_lang,
        ]
        gen_result = subprocess.run(gen_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    
        # If generate failed with non-zero exit, that's acceptable for error cases
        if gen_result.returncode != 0:
            return
    
        # If generate succeeded, run test and expect error status
        ext = LANG_EXT[target_lang]
        solution = case_dir / f"solution.{ext}"
        test_cmd = entrypoint_argv + [
            "test", str(solution), str(case_dir), "--lang", target_lang
        ]
        test_result = subprocess.run(test_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    
        # Should get error status or exit code 2
        if test_result.returncode == 2:
            return  # Expected error exit code
    
        try:
            result = json.loads(test_result.stdout.strip())

        # If generate succeeded, run test and expect error status

        ]
        test_result = subprocess.run(test_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    
        # Should get error status or exit code 2
